title: Saving Sea Turtles
note: Grace Buschiazzo - South Carolina Aquarium, Sea Turtle Care Center

paragraphs: Grace Buschiazzo (above) is a marine biologist. She works at the South Carolina Aquarium. She is part of its Sea Turtle Care Center.
Sea turtles can get sick. They can get hurt. The team at the care center treats them.
This turtle is getting scanned. It has to be strong and healthy. Then it can go back to the sea.
Another turtle swallowed fishing line. Doctors did surgery. They removed it. The turtle was saved.
article.credit: 출처: TIME for Kids, "Saving Sea Turtles" (https://www.timeforkids.com/k1/saving-sea-turtles/)

questions.q: What does the team at the care center do?
questions.answer: They treat sea turtles that are sick or hurt.

questions.q: When can a turtle go back to the sea?
questions.answer: When it is strong and healthy.

writing.prompt: Write one sentence about why the care center is important.
